title: Using Open-Ended Stressor Responses to Predict Depressive Symptoms across Demographics

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing vocabulary (log-odds-ratio, LIWC) and topic distribution differences in open-ended stressor text responses between men and women, and measuring performance disparities in depression prediction models using the ϵ-Differential Equalized Odds (ϵ-D) fairness metric.

Analyzing vocabulary and topic distribution differences in stressor responses across racial and ethnic groups (White, African American, Asian American, Hispanic/Latinx), and assessing performance disparities in downstream depression prediction models using the ϵ-Differential Equalized Odds metric.

Evaluating depression prediction models' performance fairness across combined demographic subgroups (e.g., African American Women) to check for 'Fairness Gerrymandering' using the ϵ-Differential Equalized Odds metric.
